purpose: Fix the synthetic lowbit down-stream probe data pattern and re-run default-off plus probe-mode parity checks for IQ1_S/IQ1_M/Q2_K.
root_cause_fixed: The previous synthetic fill_pattern used size_t arithmetic in (i % 17) - 8. Values below 8 underflowed, producing huge floats and NaN/Inf after quant/dequant. The harness now casts to int before subtracting.

decision.meaning: The dedicated lowbit down-stream entry can compute correct synthetic rows when given valid quantized data, but this still does not prove full-model correctness, real compact GGUF layout compatibility, prompt-general token rate, RAM, or TTFT.
decision.next_step: Use real compact-target tensors or a real GGUF/expert-pack extraction path for parity before enabling any production lowbit down-stream model run.
